reasoning_content: The Vite dev server serves MainPage modules and the page imports work. Note vite dev log had "Failed to scan for dependencies" due to the missing UserInfo.vue in dep-scan; but that only affects dep pre-bundling optimization. Wait, but that could still break the app if optimizeDeps fails. Let me check what error occurred: "Failed to scan for dependencies from entries: /workspace/resources/js/app.ts". This is a dep-scan error but the server still runs and serves modules. However the actual app.ts module request - did it return 200 or error? It returned 200. But the error came from dep scan which scans all imports. Let's verify app.ts content served by curl.
